hypothesis: An exact-equivalent tokenless 3-input unknown-role causal learner that searches only unordered input triples should preserve AAI-12W fitted programs and three-step forecasts while reducing all-model fit/cold/forecast wall time by at least 2x and meeting a 12x cap versus the fastest fully fitted nontrivial conventional control on newly born mechanical worlds.
intervention: Actual one-bit flip do action per source transition, public x0,y0,x1,y1,action. Evaluation receives x0,y0 and three actions but not intermediate y; predicts final y3 from latent update y1=y0 XOR x_k0 XOR f(x_a,x_b,x_c) XOR x_k1, with all roles and relation f hidden.

source_gen.novel_masks: Sort m=0..255 by SHA256 ASCII 'AAI12X|novel-mask|m'; select first 16 masks for which each of three variables is essential (one input flip changes some truth-table output), excluding W used masks [150,232,210,108,182,60,202,99,113,121,42,173].
source_gen.roles: For each fixture,phase,world, sort i=0..7 by SHA256('AAI12X|fixture|phase|world|role|i'); novel source uses roles[:3] and observation role[3]; familiar uses roles[:2] and observation role[2]; negative uses roles[:4] and observation role[4].
source_gen.fit: Order n=0..255 by SHA256('AAI12X|fixture|phase|world|x|n'); first 48 distinct x are training predecessors; each training initial y0 from SHA256(...|'train-y'|n) first byte LSB, action SHA256(...|'train-action'|n) first eight bytes as unsigned big-endian mod8, perform actual one-bit do to obtain x1,y1.
source_gen.eval: From remaining x, first 64 for which all 3 predecessor states under actions derived from SHA256(...|'eval-action'|n|step) are absent from training predecessors; initial y0 from SHA256(...|'eval-y'|n) first byte LSB; withhold y1,y2,y3 from model and score final y3. If fewer than 64 admissible cases INVALID.

reference.method: Copy unchanged W learner.py to reference_w.py and use exact same fully fitted conventional model training and forecasts.

optimization.proof: Each ordered permutation of a three-input role set is a bijective reindexing of the eight unrestricted truth-table cells; mismatch/coverage are invariant and lex tie always favors sorted triple.
optimization.specific: Replace 8*P(7,3)=1680 role hypotheses with 8*C(7,3)=280, preserving majority tie rule, mismatch/coverage criterion and lex ordering. Precompute ternary input codes and recurrence residual only from public rows. Keep exact reference program schema, checkpoint/restore and forecasts.
optimization.equivalence: Require exact k,abc,mask match to original W candidate on all 72 new worlds and all 4608 predictions. No hidden source law/roles in learner.

gates.benchmark: Three source-identical local runs, all 3 must satisfy time ratios (include fit+canonical cold restore+all 3-action forecasts; report common source generation separately). Exclude trivial no-learning persistence from fastest fitted denominator.
gates.classify: DEV_GO_SCIENCE_UNVERIFIED if all pass; otherwise DEV_NO_GO_NO_SCIENCE; execution/leakage/equal-observation failures => INVALID_ENGINEERING

stop: One frozen source-only screen and two identical timing/determinism repeats; no after-result tuning, extra cohorts, altered threshold, hidden truth use, native integration, merge or promotion.
